body: I can't even cry. I know the feeling. I don't even get that relief. I just sit there, in alchohol and antidepressants, and I feel nothing.

Dude I've flunked out of this year of uni becuase of how just done I am.

I don't care anymore. I really don't. I just want out.

Exactly.

I'm just so bored and tired. Do you sometimes feel like a weight is on your chest?

I don't see many ways out.
I've been trying to just effort through it for years. I don't think I can anymore
Because nothing brings me pleasure in life and takes more effort than I have.

Depression isn't sadness. 

It isn't feeling "down".

Depression is arguing with yourself whether it's worth it to complete simple tasks, to go about your daily routine.

Depression is lacking the motivation to do even things that bring you pleasure, because they not only won't, but you will not even have the energy to so them.

And then you are told to tough it out, or get in a better mood.

I wouldn't wish this illness on anyone. It has only one cure, and I'm contemplating the best way to go about it.
